entries.note: Grimsby 2003 (PMID 12869762) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Opener untested with non-member compound, product_in_model false: fine.

Meininger 2011 (PMID 21994424) quote verbatim; Eiki 2011 model_src (PMID 21937665) reports MK-0941 lowering glucose in mice/dogs, -48% OGTT AUC. Downstream glucose readout moved in patients: same holds.
Quote verbatim. Note text cites MK-0941 16-day/4-day data, which is Eiki 2011, not the cited Grimsby 2003; tidy the note, status fine.

Zhang 2013 (PMID 23263772) quote verbatim; NCT01024244 terminated 'due to nonclinical safety findings', results 2011-10-26. Model was fitted to patient MAD data, not preclinical; flip from contra rests on that. See rule question.
Opener; quote verbatim.

Abstract confirms primary endpoint was A1C at Week 14 and was met; non-sustained by week 30 correctly kept partial. AZD1656 metformin patient_trial (PMID 23464532, NCT01020123 results 2012-11-26) quote verbatim.
Kiyosue quote verbatim; primary 4-month HbA1c not significant (p=0.30). Baker 2014 (PMID 24772484) 'in marked contrast to clinical findings' confirmed. Contra beats MK-0941 same.

Vella 2019 (PMID 30651321) quote verbatim; status same under model_change is defensible. Fix fields: model_first_use_year should predate 2019 (genetic rationale guided TTP399 design); dorzagliatin is dual-acting, so its Phase 3s do not test a hepatoselective genetics model.
Opener; quote verbatim. But see missing: MK-0941 2011 triglyceride rise against a rodent model silent on lipids.
Retro status is right (De Ceuninck postdates Meininger). But the year should be 2012: Crossref shows the BJP paper online 2012 (record created 2012-08-28, published-online 2012-12-20), not 2013.
entries.adjudication_note: Status agreed (drafter rule: a retrodiction that reproduced the human data is retro). Rule 6 dating: De Ceuninck model side was online 2012, so the paired comparison dates to 2012, not 2013.

entries.note: Liang 2024 quote verbatim. An earlier tier-4 meta-analysis (Frontiers Endocrinol 2023, doi 10.3389/fendo.2023.1175198) already showed GKA-raised triglycerides (WMD +0.322 mmol/L, P=0.001). The flip is blocked if the missing 2011 contra is added.
entries.adjudication_note: 'A failed model stays failed on its track' (contra rule): Baker 2014, a rodent retrodiction on this track, failed to reproduce the patient triglyceride rise, so neither the 2023 meta-analysis nor Liang 2024 can return the track to same.

entries.note: Liu 2017 (PMID 28000102) abstract has the quote verbatim. Opener untested at 2014 is a proxy (FIP NCT02077452 started 2014-03; HV data NCT01952535 ended 2013-12), allowed under rule 6; not verifiable that the model existed then.

Quote verbatim (abstract). Comparison is to values 'fitted from observed clinical data' plus a sinogliatin patient popPK/PD, epub Dec 2016, two years after NCT02077452 completed (2014-09). Nothing shows the projection was fixed first: retro.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 10 with rule 7 dating: Liu epub 2016 post-dates the 2014 first-in-patient data and fits the projection against them; no filing or registry shows it was fixed first, so a reproduction is retro, not same.

entries.note: Same Liu 2017 abstract sentence, verbatim. Untested opener at the FIP start (2014-03) is a permitted proxy.

'nearly identical ... (0.82 vs. 0.78%)' verbatim in abstract. Published after the patient HbA1c data were in hand and the abstract gives no evidence the projection was locked before them; prospective status rests only on 'learn-research-confirm' framing: retro.
entries.adjudication_note: Rule 10: Model C (HbA1c compartment) was assembled and reported in 2016 after the observed 1-month HbA1c was known; 'learn-research-confirm' framing is not a dated prospective projection, so the 0.82 vs 0.78% match is retro.

entries.note: Diabetes 2025 (PMID 40272935, PMC12278794) abstract has the quote verbatim. Opener at 2025, first use of this islet perifusion comparison on member drugs.
Quote verbatim in Article highlights. Run 2025, after SEED/DAWN (Nat Med 2022) primaries: retro is right; paper titled as explaining dorzagliatin's clinical success.
Same abstract sentence, verbatim. Opener 2025 untested.

Quote verbatim. MK-0941 hypoglycaemia public since Meininger 2011; islet result reproduces it 14 years later, so retro; comparison_stated false is correct since the abstract does not name hypoglycaemia.
Wang 2024 (PMID 38951793, PMC11218184) Methods quote verbatim. Opener 2024, run after GKA trial lipid signals; untested.

Quote verbatim. Full text says dorzagliatin and TTP399 'did not cause hypertriglyceridemia', yet SEED/DAWN reported ~20% TG rise and hyperlipidaemia 12-14% vs 9-11%: dorzagliatin's own TG rise is the cleaner contra pairing than the pooled meta-analysis. Source_calls_it is the authors' 'match'.

entries.rule: safety: silence contradicted on a harm the species could show; contra stays failed on its track
entries.note: Field status: 'same' -> 'contra' from 2011. Eiki 2011 (PMID 21937665, epub 2011-09-21) MK-0941 rodent/dog abstract reports glucose, PK, durability only, silent on lipids; Meininger 2011 (epub 2011-10-12) MK-0941 raised triglycerides. Insert contra 2011 before safety 2.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: does a pharmacology paper's silence on lipids (Eiki 2011, abstract only, no public tox data) count as the model's silence contradicted under the safety rule, or is it rule 5 'unpublished' and not scored?

entries.rule: retrodiction that failed to reproduce human data is contra; a failed model stays failed
entries.note: Field status: 'same' -> 'contra' (2014, retrodiction true). Baker 2014 (PMID 24772484, doi 10.1111/bph.12504) abstract verbatim: two GKAs in Zucker rats and gk(wt/del) mice 'without increases in plasma or hepatic triglycerides', after MK-0941's 2011 rise. Track cannot return to same.
entries.adjudication_note: Retrodiction rule: Baker 2014 ran GKAs in Zucker rats and gk(wt/del) mice after MK-0941's 2011 triglyceride rise and found no triglyceride increase: failed to reproduce, contra; a failed model stays failed, blocking the 2024 same.

missing: safety 2011: MK-0941 raised triglycerides (and hypoglycaemia) in patients (Meininger 2011, doi 10.2337/dc11-1200), while the rodent model of record (Eiki 2011) was silent on lipids that rodents can show (De Ceuninck 2013). Arguably contra (silence contradicted), which would keep later rodent-model safety entries from flipping to same.
dose 2011: MK-0941 dose reached and the Week-14 primary met (Meininger 2011): the 'reached, drug worked' row gives dose same in 2011 before the AZD1656 contra.

efficacy patient_trials: PF-04991532 (hepatoselective member) met the 12-week HbA1c primary in NCT01336738 (450 and 750 mg vs placebo, p=0.0017 and 0.0003; results posted 2013-08-06) and NCT01338870 (results 2013-04-23). No status change.
efficacy patient_trials: PF-04937319 (nerigliatin) met the 12-week HbA1c primary at 100 mg (-0.45 to -0.47%) in two studies, Amin 2015 doi 10.1111/dom.12474. No status change.

safety: LY2599506 Phase 2s (NCT01024244, NCT01029795) were terminated for 'nonclinical safety findings'. The model flagged a harm before patients showed it, and nobody compared it in patients, so it is not scored but is worth a note.

safety: Baker 2014 (doi 10.1111/bph.12504) is a rodent model that showed no triglyceride rise, against the patient hyperlipidaemia signal. It is a second rodent result that conflicts with De Ceuninck.
rule_questions: Dose: does a semi-mechanistic model fitted to the drug's own patient MAD data (LY2599506 GIG model) count as a 'model' with model_change: true that can turn a contra cell back to same? It is a human-to-human extrapolation, not a preclinical system, and its trials stopped before efficacy was fully shown.

Safety: when a model's only public sources are pharmacology papers (no tox review, no NDA), is their silence on a harm the species can show (rodent triglycerides) enough to score contra when patients show it?

Efficacy: can a human-genetic rationale for a hepatoselective drug (TTP399) count as the model for later, non-hepatoselective members (dorzagliatin), or is it a separate model_id limited to the drugs designed from it?
Dating: TTP399 Phase 2 results were presented in 2016 (ADA), before Vella 2019. Does a conference abstract or press release set the entry year under rule 6?

Model-informed drug development papers (Liu 2017 sinogliatin PK/PD) published after the first-in-patient data, claiming a learn-research-confirm projection: without a dated pre-trial record of the projection, does the default fall to retro (checker) or to the paper's framing (drafter)?

Two-arm drug-target MR (GCK vs GCKR proxies) under one model_id: when one arm reproduces the class harm and the other contradicts it, which arm is the class proxy? Safety 7 scores the GCK arm contra on dorzagliatin's TG rise.
